title: Cats Accidentally Fall Into Pool While Running Around Poolside
description:
It was reported that a couple had moved into a new home with a backyard and pool after combining their five cats. The cats had enjoyed the outdoor space, often asking to be let out. Security footage had shown some falling into the pool, while one mischievously pushed others in.
